headline: Giovanny Rodríguez climbs to 67th on ARC-2

sections.text: Giovanny Rodríguez gained 10.00 to reach 41.53, moving from 456th to 67th on the ARC-AGI-2 public board.
The climb carries Rodríguez into the top 100 after starting the day outside it. Public standings remain provisional.
